motivation: post hoc supplied pooled completion finding; this is a new prospective hypothesis, not confirmation of the original route
derived_seed_rule: SHA256 ASCII first8 little endian modulo(2^31-1)
replay: actual full negative draw and full permutation/tail arrays; externally pinned 100 epoch receipts; same stream across all3 arms

selection.serving_route: arm's fixed pooled mean completion route

dataset_admission_owner: root; source is Collab-shaped and requires a separate adapter/qualification for another task

J_P_F_P.target_completion: mean of native clamped weights, then same vector for every recipient
J_P_F_P.main: mean native BCE over all member logits, separate positive and negative query means
J_P_F_P.auxiliary: GRAN-attributed exact J vs matched F on same observation slots

C_mu.slot_map: 195->64 ReLU->64 ReLU, twice for original/swapped roles
C_mu.precision: native FP32 neural maps, FP64 ESP/normalizer/marginals/NLL
C_mu.readout: native nonlinear decoder D(E[Z]); not expected decoder E[D(Z)]

futility_rules: Stop pooled proposal if J_P does not improve served ranking over F_P
Do not claim pooled-bank quality improvement unless J_P also improves over P0; both J and F auxiliaries could harm ranking
Stop bank-specific contribution if C_mu matches or exceeds J_P
Do not attribute source-zero-only fit improvement to useful dependencies
Suspend mechanism claim if capable complete control is infeasible
scientific_boundary: single seed futility screen only; positive result requires prospectively fixed fresh replication; no novelty, higher-order necessity, private association or manuscript success claim

P0.architecture: same fresh pooled four-member bank as J_P/F_P
P0.main: same mean native member BCE, separate positive/negative query means
P0.serve: same pooled clamped completion, mean raw logits

lambda_justification: lambda1 inherited as a fixed initial pilot convention; no substantive tuned-strength justification. Later lambda selection requires prospectively separated development and confirmation.
likelihood_scope: fixed realized query/masked context source-pattern density; no graph posterior or globally coherent active-dropout training claim
